target.description: Target is the full resource name of the resource to which the policy will be bound. Immutable once set.
target.rationale: Restricts policy binding scope to approved project principals only, preventing unauthorized identity binding.

principal_set.description: Full resource name of the principal set used for IAM policy binding.
principal_set.rationale: Ensures only approved project-level principals can be assigned IAM boundaries.

policy.description: The resource name of the policy to be bound.
policy.rationale: Ensures only approved IAM boundary policies are attached to projects.

location.description: The location of the Policy Binding.
location.rationale: Enforcing global location ensures consistent IAM policy application across projects and prevents regional drift.

policy_binding_id.rationale: Ensures consistent naming and traceability of policy bindings.

display_name.description: Optional description of the policy binding.
display_name.non-compliant: Very long or unclear name exceeding limits

annotations.rationale: Used for tagging, auditing, and governance tracking.

policy_kind.description: The kind of policy to attach in this binding.
policy_kind.rationale: Ensures only Principal Access Boundary policies are enforced for security isolation.

condition.description: CEL expression controlling conditional policy binding.
condition.rationale: Allows fine-grained IAM control based on runtime conditions.

project.description: The project where the policy binding is applied.
project.rationale: Ensures correct project-level IAM isolation and prevents cross-project misconfiguration.
